title: K-flatness under localized open restriction
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings on its open site, and $U$ an open. Write $A$ for the underlying ring sheaf and $V=\operatorname{overFunctor}(A,U)$ for restriction to the localized ringed site [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. For every unbounded cochain complex $P$ of $A$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], if $P$ is K-flat over $R$ [def-pc-kflat-complex], then the termwise restricted complex $V(P)$ is K-flat over $R|_U$. The explicit zero-map-preservation witness only defines the map on complexes and imposes no additional mathematical hypothesis.

source.place: Tag 06YB (cohomology-lemma-check-K-flat-stalks), applied to the open subspace; Tag 03DH (sites-modules-section-localize)

proof.text: Regard the pair (X,R) as a ringed space. Let V be overFunctor on modules and let L be the explicitly constructed extension-by-zero presheaf followed by module sheafification. Apply [lem-sc-derived-open-restriction-adjunction-exact] to obtain finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation for both functors and an adjunction L left adjoint to V. The component of its unit is invertible by [lem-sc-module-extension-by-zero-unit-isiso]. Applying L termwise to any acyclic localized test complex F produces an acyclic global complex G; the unit components, natural in the differentials, give F isomorphic to V(G).

Construct the comparison V(Tot(G tensor P)) isomorphic to Tot(V(G) tensor V(P)). The natural module tensor comparison [lem-pc-open-localized-tensor-natural] gives the isomorphism in each bidegree. Its naturality with respect to the differential in each factor yields an isomorphism of bicomplexes. The functor V is additive and preserves coproducts (it is pushforward along the cocontinuous slice-forgetful functor with identity ring map). Apply the source-library HomologicalComplex2.mapTotalIso and the total functor to that bicomplex isomorphism. This commutes with the signed differential and infinite direct sums and works for unbounded complexes. The additive tensor structures used in this assembly are supplied by [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed].

Unfold [def-pc-kflat-complex] and introduce an arbitrary acyclic localized test complex F. K-flatness of P makes Tot(G tensor P) acyclic. Exactness of V from the first step makes its restriction acyclic. Transport this acyclicity through the total-tensor comparison from the second step, and then through tensoring the unit complex isomorphism F isomorphic to V(G) with V(P). This proves the defining test for F. For an empty open the same exact functors and invertible unit apply, with no points or nonzero assumptions.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03DI (extension-by-zero construction), 03DJ (exactness), 00A7 (invertible open extension unit), and 01CD (tensor restriction); direct acyclic-test proof using exact extension by zero and natural totalization, assembled in Lean by E3.

theorem open_localized_restriction_isKFlat
    {X : TopCat.{u}} (R : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) CommRingCat.{u})
    (U : TopologicalSpace.Opens X)
    (hzero : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} ((sheafCompose
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R) U).PreservesZeroMorphisms)
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R)) ℤ)
    (hP : IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := R) P) :
    letI := hzero
    IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := R.over U)
      (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} ((sheafCompose
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R) U).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P)
